#!/bin/sh
set -eu

case "$1 ${2:-}" in
  "intent shape")
    slug=$3
    project=
    while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
      if [ "$1" = --project ]; then
        project=$2
        shift 2
      else
        shift
      fi
    done
    mkdir -p "$project/.kogen/intents/$slug"
    printf '%s\n' 'shaped Intent' > "$project/.kogen/intents/$slug/intent.md"
    printf '%s\n' '{"slug":"task","usage":[]}'
    ;;
  "intent approve")
    exit 0
    ;;
  "queue start")
    exit 1
    ;;
  "status "*)
    shift 2
    project=
    while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
      if [ "$1" = --project ]; then
        project=$2
        shift 2
      else
        shift
      fi
    done
    run_dir="$project/.kogen/test-run"
    mkdir -p "$run_dir"
    printf '%s\n' 'candidate implementation' > "$run_dir/candidate.diff"
    python3 - "$run_dir/candidate.diff" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

source_path = sys.argv[1]
print(json.dumps({
    "status": "failed",
    "candidate_diffs": [{
        "attempt": "builder",
        "file": "candidate.diff",
        "source_path": source_path,
        "protected_paths_changed": [],
        "red_checks": [{"name": "tests", "exit_level": 1}],
        "acceptance_items": [{"id": "A1"}],
    }],
    "attempts": [],
    "escalations": [],
    "model_stages": [],
    "phase_timings": [],
}))
PY

    ;;
  *)
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
